pages.text: Snow lay knee-deep. Firewood was stacked beneath a snowy tree. Grandma was about to light the fire for the room.
"I'll carry all the firewood." Yuki strode toward the tree.
Yuki filled both arms. One, two, three, four. More and more logs went on top.
They reached Yuki's chin, hiding everything ahead. "This will do it all in one trip."
Yuki wobbled along the snowy path. Ahead, Momo barked. "I can't see, Momo."
Yuki's foot caught on the threshold. The logs tumbled down.
They sank into the snow. Yuki dug them out one by one. "My hands are freezing."
Grandma placed three logs in Yuki's arms, then let go.
Yuki went back and forth, three logs at a time. Everything ahead was clear above the logs.
The firewood stood neatly stacked outside the room. Yuki clapped the dust from their hands.
